title: Underwriting Guide: Number of Cardinal Personal Auto Policies per Customer
content:
A customer may hold up to 3 Cardinal Personal Auto Policy contracts at one time.

## Rule

1. **What counts.** Policies whose status is bound, in force or cancel pending count toward the limit of 3. Cancelled, nonrenewed and expired policies do not count.
2. **Scope of a policy.** Each policy is written for a single garaging state and a single household.
3. **Issuing a new policy.** A new policy may be issued only when the customer currently holds fewer than 3 counted policies. This is read from the company's policy records for that customer, not from the customer's own account of what they hold.
4. **Beyond the limit.** A request for a further policy beyond the limit is declined. The customer may instead add the vehicle to an existing policy, within that policy's own vehicle cap.

## Decision table

| Counted policies the customer holds now (bound, in force or cancel pending) | New policy request |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | May be issued |
| 3 | Declined; the vehicle may instead be added to an existing policy within that policy's vehicle cap |

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer with two in-force policies and one cancelled policy holds 2 counted policies. A third policy may be issued.
- A customer with two in-force policies and one cancel-pending policy holds 3 counted policies. A fourth is declined.
- A customer with three expired policies holds no counted policies.
